# PiTTy v0.6.68

- **Fix old text appearing through new text:** OpenTUI 0.4.x can let a right-edge glyph wrap into the next physical row and then incorrectly treat stale screen cells as up-to-date. PiTTy now disables terminal autowrap only while owning an interactive Linux/macOS terminal, and restores it after shutdown. The change covers messages, tools, compaction, subagent inspectors, and the sidebar.
- **No redraw penalty:** Two terminal control sequences per run, not forced full-screen repaint every frame. The renderer still uses incremental updates.
- **Safety:** Disabled for redirected output and Windows. Automatic restoration on normal shutdown and crash paths. Opt out with `PITTY_ALLOW_AUTOWRAP=1`.
- **Regression tests:** Real OpenTUI text-update tests for seven components, focused terminal-mode lifecycle tests, and a manual isolated tmux right-edge reproduction.

Upstream context: https://github.com/anomalyco/opentui/issues/1187. If a terminal is left with wrap disabled after a forced kill, run `printf '\033[?7h'` in the terminal.

Upgrade with `pitty upgrade --version 0.6.68`. Staged installation activates on the next PiTTy launch.
